cohort: The study cohort included women undergoing a trial of labor for a singleton gestation with cephalic presentation between 36 0/7 and 40 0/7 weeks.
finding: Induction of labor in gestations complicated by isolated oligohydramnios at 36 weeks gestational age is associated with an increased risk for adverse neonatal outcome.
mod_finding: Induction of labor at 36 weeks among IO gestations was associated with adverse neonatal outcome.
